name: Mount Sen
text: Mountain in Sumoto, Hyōgo prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Mount Sen
depictions.text: Mount Sen (千ヶ峰) is a mountain in northern Mount Kasagata in Harima, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke climbed atop the mountain and oversaw the land. South of the peak, Naoe found a place to practice her kuji-kiri.
